name: Quietime
description_zh: Quietime 静夜工作室，摄影作品、影像与委托拍摄。
description_en: Quietime is a small photography studio. We make personal series, short films and commissioned work, and we take our time over them.
statement_zh: 在苏州拍人像，也去演唱会现场录整场。
statement_en: Portraits in Suzhou, and whole concerts filmed from the crowd.
copyright: Copyright © Quietime Photography. All rights reserved.
home_teaser_zh: 约拍，或者想用这里的照片和录像，都可以写信来。
home_teaser_en: For a shoot, or to use a photograph or a film from here, write to us.
about_intro_zh:
静夜工作室在苏州。

网站上的照片和演唱会录像，都是工作室自己拍的。照片多是人像，拍在旧园里、树林里和夜里；也有一卷是城市的天色。录像是火星演唱会的全程、直拍和双机位混剪，在看台上拍：杭州那场用的是 DJI Pocket 3 和 DJI Mic 2，福州那场在第一排。

约拍和作品授权，都可以写信来谈。
about_intro_en:
Quietime is a studio in Suzhou.

The photographs and concert films on this site were all made here. Most of the photographs are portraits, taken in an old garden, among trees and at night, and one roll is the city and its weather. The films are whole concerts, single camera close ups and two camera cuts, shot from the stands. Hangzhou was filmed on a DJI Pocket 3 with a DJI Mic 2, and Fuzhou from the front row.

Write to us about a shoot or about using the work.

services.text_en: In a place you already know.

services.text_zh: 网站上的照片和录像，可以授权使用。
services.text_en: The photographs and films on this site can be licensed.

contact_lede_zh: 告诉我们想拍什么、在哪里、大概什么时候。收到后会尽快回复，先聊想法，再谈安排。
contact_lede_en: Tell us what you have in mind, where, and roughly when. We will reply as soon as we can, and start with the idea before the plan.

process.text_zh: 说说想拍什么，一起看参考，定下风格和地点。
process.text_en: Tell us what you want to shoot. We look at references together and settle the style and the place.

process.text_zh: 确认日期、时长、人数与交付内容，给出明确的报价。
process.text_en: Date, length, people and what you will receive, with a clear quote.

process.text_zh: 按约定的时间到场拍摄。
process.text_en: We arrive at the agreed time and shoot.

process.text_zh: 先发初选给你挑，再精修交付。
process.text_en: You choose from a first edit, and we finish the ones you pick.

faq.q_en: When will the photographs be ready?
faq.a_zh: 看拍摄的内容和张数。约拍时会把交付日期写清楚。
faq.a_en: It depends on what we shoot and how many pictures. The delivery date is set down when we book.

faq.a_zh: 可以。交通和住宿另算，约拍时一起说清楚。
faq.a_en: Yes. Travel and lodging are extra, and we settle them when we book.

faq.q_en: Can the photographs be used commercially?
faq.a_zh: 个人委托默认仅限个人使用；商业用途请在沟通时说明，我们会签署授权协议。
faq.a_en: Personal commissions are for personal use. If you need the pictures for commercial work, tell us early and we will put a licence in writing.

faq.q_en: How far ahead should I book?
faq.a_zh: 越早越好，节假日的档期会紧一些。
faq.a_en: The earlier the better. Holidays fill up first.
